result.detail: All three testbenches use the same top module name, tb_pwm_repro, so the platform's top (taken from the first file's entry) is valid for each file run on its own. Every wait loop is bounded at 64 cycles, and a watchdog makes sure $finish and a single verdict line happen even if the design locks high. With all three bugs present, duty 5 can hold the output high. Suggested follow-ups: run veritriage.investigate on each log alone, because the combined session's 30% unknown_failure may hide per-log classes. Also rerun each failing test with the same seed before closing the buckets.
